Willow

You can cancel your order by logging into your account here and selecting the ‘cancel’ button, as long as we haven’t started preparing it. For next-day delivery orders, preparation begins immediately, so cancellation may not be possible. We recommend cancelling at least 48 hours before the delivery date, especially during busy periods like Christmas, Valentine’s Day, or Mother’s Day.
